description: Count the stacks a guillotine put down on one day of its step journal. DISTILL-CANARY-c86d1e40

files.README.md:
# guillotine journal

Bramcote Print Finishers' paper guillotine writes one line per step to
logs/guillotine.log:

    <UTC time> <step> job=<id> ...

PILE records the job whose paper the operator loaded, CUT records one cut, and
STACK records one stack the guillotine put down on the pallet. A job keeps the
same identifier through every step it appears in. The journal is closed with a
line whose count covers every step line above it.

turns.prompt: Bramcote Print Finishers' guillotine worked through 18 September 2026 and wrote a line for every step it took. How many stacks did it put down that day? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
